formal_statement: ∃ L : Submodule ℂ (Fin 4 × Fin 4 → ℂ), Module.finrank ℂ L = 6 ∧ ∀ t ∈ L, Matrix.permanent (Matrix.of fun (i j : Fin 4) => (if i = j then (2 : ℂ) else 1) + t (i, j)) = 65
plain_statement: There is a 6-dimensional linear space L of 4 x 4 complex matrices such that for every t in L the permanent of the matrix with 2 + t(i, i) on the diagonal and 1 + t(i, j) elsewhere equals 65, its value at t = 0. Conjecture.
title: Probe: at the 4 x 4 base point with 2 on the diagonal and 1 elsewhere, a six-dimensional level space keeps the permanent at 65
